Tang Empire.name: Li Zhi
Tang Empire.title: Emperor Gaozong
Tang Empire.note: Empress Wu held much of the power from the 660s.

Tang Empire.name: Li Dan
Tang Empire.title: Emperor Ruizong
Tang Empire.note: Empress Dowager Wu ruled in his name.

Tang Empire.name: Wu Zhao
Tang Empire.title: Wu Zetian
Tang Empire.note: Ruled as emperor of her own Zhou dynasty.

Tang Empire.name: Li Zhu
Tang Empire.title: Emperor Ai
Tang Empire.note: A puppet of Zhu Wen, who ended the Tang in 907.
Tang Empire.note_zh: 受朱温控制，907年唐朝被朱温所灭。

Anxi and Beiting Protectorates.name: Guo Xin
Anxi and Beiting Protectorates.title: Protector-General of Anxi
Anxi and Beiting Protectorates.note: Held out in the Tarim Basin, cut off from Chang'an, until about 808 (estimate).
Anxi and Beiting Protectorates.note_zh: 在与长安隔绝的情况下坚守西域，约至808年（估计）。

Western Gokturk Khaganate.name: Ashina Helu
Western Gokturk Khaganate.title: Ishbara Khagan
Western Gokturk Khaganate.note: Defeated by the Tang general Su Dingfang in 657.

Second Turkic Khaganate.name: Tengri
Second Turkic Khaganate.title: Tengri Khagan
Second Turkic Khaganate.note: The khaganate fell to the Uyghurs in 744.

Uyghurs.name: Zhangxin
Uyghurs.title: Zhangxin Khagan
Uyghurs.note: The khaganate was destroyed by the Kyrgyz in 840.

Tibetan Empire.name: Songtsen Gampo
Tibetan Empire.title: Tsenpo Songtsen Gampo
Tibetan Empire.note: Start year varies by source (618 or 629).
Tibetan Empire.note_zh: 即位年份各说不一（618年或629年）。

Tibetan Empire.name: Mangsong Mangtsen
Tibetan Empire.title: Tsenpo Mangsong Mangtsen
Tibetan Empire.note: The minister Gar Tongtsen and his sons held real power.
Tibetan Empire.note_zh: 大相禄东赞父子掌握实权。

Tibetan Empire.name: Me Agtsom
Tibetan Empire.title: Tsenpo Tride Tsuktsen
Tibetan Empire.note: Married the Tang Princess Jincheng in 710.

Tibetan Empire.name: Ralpacan
Tibetan Empire.title: Tsenpo Ralpacan
Tibetan Empire.note: Signed the 821-822 peace treaty with Tang.

Tibetan Empire.name: Langdarma
Tibetan Empire.title: Tsenpo Langdarma
Tibetan Empire.note: After his death the empire broke apart.
Tibetan Empire.note_zh: 他死后吐蕃王朝分裂瓦解。

Nan-Zhao.name: Piluoge
Nan-Zhao.title: King Piluoge
Nan-Zhao.note: United the six zhao kingdoms around Erhai Lake.

Nan-Zhao.name: Geluofeng
Nan-Zhao.title: King Geluofeng
Nan-Zhao.note: Broke with Tang and defeated its armies in the 750s.
Nan-Zhao.note_zh: 与唐朝决裂，750年代多次击败唐军。

Nan-Zhao.name: Shunhuazhen
Nan-Zhao.title: King Shunhuazhen
Nan-Zhao.note: Nanzhao ended in 902 when Zheng Maisi seized power.

Balhae.name: Dae In-su
Balhae.title: King Seon
Balhae.note: Balhae reached its greatest size; Tang called it 'the flourishing land in the east'.
Balhae.note_zh: 渤海国疆域达到最大，唐人称之为“海东盛国”。

Silla.name: Kim Beopmin
Silla.title: King Munmu
Silla.note: Unified most of the Korean peninsula by 676.

Yamato.name: Suiko
Yamato.title: Empress Suiko
Yamato.note: Prince Shōtoku acted as regent for much of her reign.

Yamato.name: Saimei
Yamato.title: Empress Saimei
Yamato.note: The same woman as Empress Kōgyoku, reigning a second time.

Yamato.name: Tenji
Yamato.title: Emperor Tenji
Yamato.note: Ruled as crown prince from 661; formally enthroned in 668.
Yamato.note_zh: 661年起以皇太子身份执政，668年正式即位。

Japan.name: Shōtoku
Japan.title: Empress Shōtoku
Japan.note: The same woman as Empress Kōken, reigning a second time.

Japan.name: Kanmu
Japan.title: Emperor Kanmu
Japan.note: Moved the capital to Heian-kyō (Kyoto) in 794.

eastern-turks.note: Li Jing's decisive raid was made with only about 3,000 picked cavalry.
eastern-turks.note_zh: 李靖奔袭定襄时只带了约三千精骑。

anxi.note: King Qu Wentai died as the Tang army approached; his son surrendered.
anxi.note_zh: 唐军将至时高昌王麴文泰病死，其子麴智盛出降。

goguryeo-falls.note: Goguryeo was weakened by a feud among the sons of Yeon Gaesomun.
goguryeo-falls.note_zh: 渊盖苏文死后诸子内讧，高句丽实力大减。

sides.name: Tang
sides.troops_text: c. 30,000 Tang and allied troops (Chinese sources)
sides.troops_text_zh: 唐军及蕃兵约3万（据中国史书）

talas.note: The Karluks, Tang allies, switched sides during the battle.
talas.note_zh: 唐军盟友葛逻禄在战斗中倒戈。

an-lushan.note: Tang won only with Uyghur help and by pardoning rebel generals.
an-lushan.note_zh: 唐朝依靠回纥援兵并招降叛将才平定叛乱。

luoyang-falls-755.note: Feng Changqing was later executed for the defeat.
luoyang-falls-755.note_zh: 封常清后来因兵败被处死。

tong-pass-756.losses: Tang army destroyed; Geshu Han captured

suiyang-siege.note: The city fell after about ten months, but the long defence kept the rebels out of the south.
suiyang-siege.note_zh: 睢阳坚守约十个月后陷落，但拖住了叛军南下。
suiyang-siege.losses_zh: 守城军民几乎全部罹难

changan-recaptured-757.note: Numbers are from the official histories and are probably inflated.
changan-recaptured-757.note_zh: 兵力数字出自正史，可能有所夸大。

sides.name: Tibetan Empire
sides.troops_text: over 200,000 with allies (official figure, probably inflated)
sides.troops_text_zh: 连同附从各部二十余万（史书记载，可能夸大）

tibet-changan.note: Emperor Daizong fled to Shanzhou; the Tibetans left after about 15 days.
tibet-changan.note_zh: 唐代宗逃往陕州，吐蕃军约15天后撤走。

dunhuang-tibet.note: The city surrendered on terms after a siege of about ten years (dates vary).
dunhuang-tibet.note_zh: 沙州被围约十年后有条件投降（年代说法不一）。

sides.name: Rebels
sides.troops_text: hundreds of thousands at the peak (estimate)

huang-chao.note: Zhu Wen was a rebel general who went over to Tang in 882; Li Keyong's Shatuo cavalry drove Huang Chao from Chang'an.
huang-chao.note_zh: 朱温原是起义军将领，882年降唐；李克用的沙陀骑兵把黄巢逐出长安。

guangzhou-sack.losses: Arab writer Abu Zayd gave 120,000 foreigners killed, probably exaggerated
guangzhou-sack.losses_zh: 阿拉伯作者阿布·赛义德称有12万外商被杀，可能有所夸大

sides.name: Tang
sides.troops_text: c. 2,800 Shence troops at Tong Pass

huang-chao-changan.note: The 600,000 figure is a boast, not a count.
huang-chao-changan.note_zh: “六十万”是号称之数，并非实数。

routes.name: Xuanzang's journey to India
routes.summary: The monk Xuanzang left Chang'an secretly, crossed the Tarim Basin, Central Asia and the Hindu Kush, and studied at Nalanda.
routes.summary_zh: 玄奘私自离开长安，穿越西域、中亚和兴都库什山，到那烂陀寺求学。

routes.name: Princess Wencheng goes to Tibet
routes.summary: Princess Wencheng travelled over the Riyue Mountains and the Tibetan plateau to marry Songtsen Gampo in Lhasa.
routes.summary_zh: 文成公主经日月山、穿越青藏高原，到拉萨与松赞干布成婚。

routes.name: Silk Road in the Tang
routes.summary: With the Anxi Protectorate holding the Tarim Basin, caravans moved between Chang'an and Central Asia.
routes.summary_zh: 安西都护府控制塔里木盆地，商队往来于长安与中亚之间。

routes.name: Gao Xianzhi marches to Talas
routes.summary: Gao Xianzhi led his army from Kucha over the Tianshan to the Talas River, where it was defeated.
routes.summary_zh: 高仙芝率军从龟兹翻越天山，到达怛罗斯河，兵败而还。

routes.name: Jianzhen sails to Japan
routes.summary: On his sixth try, the blind monk Jianzhen reached Kyushu and then Nara, where he founded Tōshōdai-ji.
routes.summary_zh: 第六次东渡时，双目失明的鉴真终于到达九州，后至奈良，创建唐招提寺。

routes.name: An Lushan marches on the capitals
routes.summary: The rebel army rode south from Fanyang, crossed the Yellow River, took Luoyang, broke through Tong Pass and entered Chang'an.
routes.summary_zh: 叛军从范阳南下，渡过黄河，攻陷洛阳，突破潼关，进入长安。

routes.name: Huang Chao's long march
routes.summary: The rebels moved south through Zhejiang and Fujian to Guangzhou, then turned north, crossed the Yangtze and took Luoyang and Chang'an.
routes.summary_zh: 起义军经浙江、福建南下广州，又挥师北上，渡过长江，攻占洛阳和长安。

people.name: Xuanzang
people.known_for: Monk who travelled to India for 17 years and translated the sutras he brought back.
people.known_for_zh: 高僧，西行印度求法十七年，带回并翻译大量佛经。

works.title: Great Tang Records on the Western Regions

people.name: Sun Simiao
people.known_for: Revered physician, honoured as the 'King of Medicine'.
people.known_for_zh: 著名医学家，被尊为“药王”。

works.title: Essential Formulas Worth a Thousand Gold

people.name: Huineng
people.known_for: Sixth Patriarch of Chan (Zen), who taught sudden enlightenment.
people.known_for_zh: 禅宗六祖，倡导“顿悟”。
people.line_zh: 菩提本无树，明镜亦非台。
people.line_en: Bodhi is no tree; the bright mirror has no stand.

people.name: Liu Zhiji
people.known_for: Wrote the first Chinese book on how history should be written.
people.known_for_zh: 著有中国第一部史学理论专著。

people.name: Yixing
people.known_for: Buddhist monk and astronomer who made the Dayan calendar.
people.known_for_zh: 僧人、天文学家，编制《大衍历》。

people.name: Wu Daozi
people.known_for: Painter of temple murals, honoured as the 'Sage of Painting'.
people.known_for_zh: 以寺观壁画闻名，被尊为“画圣”。

people.name: Li Bai
people.known_for: Romantic poet of wine, moonlight and mountains, the 'Immortal Poet'.
people.known_for_zh: 浪漫主义诗人，被称为“诗仙”。
people.line_zh: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。
people.line_en: Before my bed the moonlight gleams, like frost upon the ground.

people.name: Wang Wei
people.known_for: Poet and painter of quiet landscapes, the 'Buddha of Poetry'.
people.known_for_zh: 山水诗人兼画家，被称为“诗佛”。
people.line_zh: 空山不见人，但闻人语响。
people.line_en: In the empty hills no one is seen, yet voices can be heard.

people.name: Jianzhen
people.known_for: Monk who reached Japan on his sixth try and founded Toshodai-ji in Nara.
people.known_for_zh: 高僧，第六次东渡终于到达日本，在奈良创建唐招提寺。

people.name: Du Fu
people.known_for: The 'Sage of Poetry', who wrote of war and suffering after the An Lushan rebellion.
people.known_for_zh: 被称为“诗圣”，记录了安史之乱前后的战乱与民间疾苦。
people.line_zh: 国破山河在，城春草木深。
people.line_en: The state is broken, yet hills and rivers remain; spring comes, and the city is deep in grass.

people.name: Yan Zhenqing
people.known_for: Calligrapher whose strong, upright style is still the model for learners.
people.known_for_zh: 书法家，楷书端庄雄伟，至今仍是习字范本。

works.title: Draft of a Requiem to My Nephew

people.name: Lu Yu
people.known_for: Wrote the first book on tea and is called the 'Sage of Tea'.
people.known_for_zh: 写出世界第一部茶学专著，被尊为“茶圣”。

people.name: Han Yu
people.known_for: Led the 'ancient prose' movement and defended Confucianism against Buddhism.
people.known_for_zh: 倡导古文运动，捍卫儒学道统。
people.line_zh: 世有伯乐，然后有千里马。
people.line_en: Only when there is a Bole are there thousand-li horses.

people.name: Bai Juyi
people.known_for: Poet who wrote in plain words about the lives of ordinary people.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人，语言通俗，常写百姓生活。
people.line_zh: 野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。
people.line_en: Wildfire cannot burn it all; the spring wind brings it back to life.

people.name: Li Shimin (Emperor Taizong of Tang)
people.known_for: Second Tang emperor whose Zhenguan reign became the model of good government.
people.known_for_zh: 唐太宗，开创“贞观之治”。

people.name: Empress Zhangsun
people.known_for: Taizong's wise empress, admired for restraint and for protecting frank ministers like Wei Zheng.
people.known_for_zh: 唐太宗皇后，贤德节俭，护佑直臣。

people.name: Wei Zheng
people.known_for: Chancellor famed for blunt remonstrance; Taizong called him the mirror for seeing his faults.
people.known_for_zh: 以直谏著称的名相，太宗称其为“镜”。

people.name: Fang Xuanling
people.known_for: Long-serving chancellor of Taizong who led compilation of the Book of Jin.
people.known_for_zh: 贞观名相，“房谋杜断”之房，主修《晋书》。

people.name: Li Jing
people.known_for: Tang general who destroyed the Eastern Turkic Khaganate in 630.
people.known_for_zh: 唐初名将，630年大破东突厥。

people.name: Li Shiji
people.known_for: Tang general who conquered Goguryeo in 668.
people.known_for_zh: 唐初名将，668年攻灭高句丽。

people.name: Wu Zetian
people.known_for: The only woman to rule China as emperor in her own right, proclaiming the Zhou dynasty in 690.
people.known_for_zh: 中国唯一女皇帝，690年改唐为周。

people.name: Shangguan Wan'er
people.known_for: Poet and Wu Zetian's secretary who drafted imperial edicts and judged court poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 女诗人，为武则天掌诏命，评定宫廷诗文。

people.name: Di Renjie
people.known_for: Upright chancellor of Wu Zetian, later legendary as the detective Judge Dee.
people.known_for_zh: 武周名相，后世“狄公案”主角。

people.name: Princess Taiping
people.known_for: Wu Zetian's powerful daughter who dominated court politics until defeated by Xuanzong.
people.known_for_zh: 武则天之女，权倾朝野，后为玄宗所诛。

people.name: Li Longji (Emperor Xuanzong of Tang)
people.known_for: Tang emperor of the brilliant Kaiyuan era whose later reign collapsed in the An Lushan Rebellion.
people.known_for_zh: 唐玄宗，开创“开元盛世”，晚年致安史之乱。

people.name: Yao Chong
people.known_for: Chancellor whose reforms helped launch the Kaiyuan golden age.
people.known_for_zh: 开元名相，革除弊政，奠定开元之治。

people.name: Zhang Jiuling
people.known_for: Last great Kaiyuan chancellor and fine poet, who warned against An Lushan.
people.known_for_zh: 开元名相、诗人，曾预言安禄山必反。

people.name: Yang Guifei
people.known_for: Xuanzong's beloved consort, one of the Four Beauties, killed at Mawei during the An Lushan Rebellion.
people.known_for_zh: 唐玄宗宠妃，四大美人之一，死于马嵬驿。

people.name: An Lushan
people.known_for: Frontier general whose 755 rebellion devastated the Tang and ended its golden age.
people.known_for_zh: 范阳节度使，755年起兵叛唐，引发安史之乱。

people.name: Guo Ziyi
people.known_for: General who recaptured both capitals from the An Lushan rebels and defended Tang for decades.
people.known_for_zh: 平定安史之乱、收复两京的中兴名将。

people.name: Li Guangbi
people.known_for: Khitan-born Tang general whose defence of Taiyuan helped crush the An–Shi rebellion.
people.known_for_zh: 契丹族名将，坚守太原，平安史之乱功与郭子仪齐名。

people.name: Gao Xianzhi
people.place_zh: 龟兹（安西都护府，今新疆库车）
people.known_for: Goguryeo-born Tang commander who crossed the Pamirs and lost the Battle of Talas in 751.
people.known_for_zh: 高句丽裔唐将，翻越帕米尔远征，751年怛罗斯之战失利。

people.name: Li Mi
people.known_for: Daoist-minded strategist and chancellor who advised four Tang emperors.
people.known_for_zh: 历仕四朝的谋臣宰相，号称“白衣山人”。

people.name: Liu Yan
people.known_for: Financial administrator who rebuilt Tang revenues with the salt monopoly and canal grain transport.
people.known_for_zh: 理财家，改革盐法与漕运，恢复唐朝财政。

people.name: Li Deyu
people.known_for: Chancellor of Emperor Wuzong, leader of the Li faction, who curbed the Uyghurs and rebels.
people.known_for_zh: 会昌名相，牛李党争李党领袖。

people.name: Huang Chao
people.known_for: Salt-smuggler rebel who captured Chang'an in 881 and fatally weakened the Tang.
people.known_for_zh: 盐商出身的起义领袖，881年攻占长安。

people.name: Princess Wencheng
people.known_for: Tang princess married to Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo in 641, bringing Chinese culture to Tibet.
people.known_for_zh: 641年嫁吐蕃赞普松赞干布，促进汉藏交流。

people.name: Zhang Yichao
people.known_for: Dunhuang leader who expelled the Tibetans in 848 and returned the Hexi Corridor to Tang.
people.known_for_zh: 848年起兵驱逐吐蕃，收复河西归唐。

people.name: Wang Bo
people.known_for: Prodigy among the Four Paragons of Early Tang, author of the Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng.
people.known_for_zh: “初唐四杰”之首，作《滕王阁序》。

works.title: Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng

people.name: Chen Zi'ang
people.known_for: Poet who called for a return to Han–Wei vigour, author of 'Climbing Youzhou Tower'.
people.known_for_zh: 倡导汉魏风骨的诗人，作《登幽州台歌》。

works.title: Song on Climbing the Youzhou Tower

people.name: Meng Haoran
people.known_for: Reclusive landscape poet of Xiangyang, author of 'Spring Dawn'.
people.known_for_zh: 山水田园诗人，作《春晓》。

people.name: Wang Changling
people.known_for: Master of the quatrain known for frontier poems such as 'Out of the Frontier'.
people.known_for_zh: “七绝圣手”，作《出塞》等边塞诗。

people.name: Gao Shi
people.known_for: Frontier poet who served Geshu Han in Hexi and later became a military governor.
people.known_for_zh: 边塞诗人，曾入哥舒翰幕府，后官至节度使。

people.name: Cen Shen
people.known_for: Frontier poet who served in the Western Regions and wrote of snow and deserts.
people.known_for_zh: 边塞诗人，两度出塞西域，作《白雪歌》。

people.name: Liu Zongyuan
people.known_for: Essayist and poet of the Classical Prose Movement, known for his Yongzhou landscape essays.
people.known_for_zh: 古文运动领袖之一，作《永州八记》《江雪》。

people.name: Liu Yuxi
people.known_for: Poet and philosopher, the 'hero of poetry', author of 'Inscription on a Humble Room'.
people.known_for_zh: “诗豪”，作《陋室铭》《乌衣巷》。

people.name: Yuan Zhen
people.known_for: Poet and chancellor, Bai Juyi's partner in the New Yuefu movement, author of the Story of Yingying.
people.known_for_zh: 与白居易倡新乐府运动，作《莺莺传》。

people.name: Li He
people.known_for: The 'ghost poet' whose dark, fantastic verse was unlike any other Tang poetry.
people.known_for_zh: “诗鬼”，诗风奇诡瑰丽。

people.name: Du Mu
people.known_for: Late Tang poet famed for elegant quatrains on history and Jiangnan, and the 'Epang Palace Rhapsody'.
people.known_for_zh: 晚唐诗人，“小李杜”之一，作《阿房宫赋》。

people.name: Li Shangyin
people.known_for: Late Tang poet of dense, allusive 'untitled' love poems.
people.known_for_zh: 晚唐诗人，以朦胧深婉的《无题》诗著称。

people.name: Wen Tingyun
people.known_for: Poet and founding master of the ci lyric, leader of the Huajian school.
people.known_for_zh: 晚唐诗人、花间派鼻祖，大力创作词。

people.name: Xue Tao
people.known_for: Chengdu courtesan-poet famed for her verse and the 'Xue Tao paper' she designed.
people.known_for_zh: 成都女诗人，创制“薛涛笺”。

people.name: Zhang Xu
people.known_for: Calligrapher whose wild cursive made him the 'Sage of Cursive Script'.
people.known_for_zh: “草圣”，以狂草著称。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 685 – 759; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作685年—759年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

people.name: Huaisu
people.known_for: Buddhist monk whose 'wild cursive' rivals Zhang Xu's.
people.known_for_zh: 僧人书法家，狂草与张旭并称“颠张醉素”。

people.name: Liu Gongquan
people.known_for: Calligrapher whose bony regular script (Liu style) is a standard model.
people.known_for_zh: 书法家，创“柳体”，与颜真卿并称“颜筋柳骨”。

people.name: Ouyang Xun
people.known_for: Calligrapher whose precise regular script (Ou style) is a classic model.
people.known_for_zh: 书法家，楷书“欧体”创始人。

people.name: Yan Liben
people.known_for: Court painter and chancellor known for the Thirteen Emperors Scroll and Emperor Taizong Receiving the Tibetan Envoy.
people.known_for_zh: 画家、宰相，作《步辇图》《历代帝王图》。

works.title: Emperor Taizong Receiving the Tibetan Envoy

people.name: Zhang Xuan
people.known_for: Kaiyuan-era court painter of aristocratic women.
people.known_for_zh: 开元宫廷画家，擅画仕女。

people.name: Yijing
people.known_for: Monk who sailed to India via Srivijaya, studied at Nalanda and translated many scriptures.
people.known_for_zh: 高僧，经海路赴印度那烂陀寺求法，译经甚多。

works.title: A Record of Buddhist Practices Sent Home from the Southern Sea

people.name: Fazang
people.known_for: Third patriarch and real systematiser of the Huayan school of Buddhism.
people.known_for_zh: 华严宗实际创立者，为武则天讲《华严经》。

people.name: Amoghavajra
people.known_for: Esoteric Buddhist master and translator, one of the four great translators of Chinese Buddhism.
people.known_for_zh: 密宗大师，四大译经家之一。

people.name: Li Chunfeng
people.known_for: Astronomer-mathematician who edited the Ten Computational Canons and made the Linde calendar.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家、数学家，注释《算经十书》，制《麟德历》。

people.name: Du You
people.known_for: Chancellor and historian who wrote the Tongdian, the first comprehensive institutional encyclopedia.
people.known_for_zh: 宰相、史学家，著《通典》。

people.name: Jia Dan
people.known_for: Chancellor and geographer who drew a vast gridded map of China and the barbarian lands.
people.known_for_zh: 宰相、地理学家，绘《海内华夷图》。

works.title: Map of Chinese and Barbarian Lands

people.name: Pei Ju
people.known_for: Sui official who managed Silk Road trade at Zhangye and wrote the Illustrated Records of the Western Regions.
people.known_for_zh: 隋臣，主持张掖互市，著《西域图记》。

works.title: Illustrated Records of the Western Regions

people.name: Wei Zhuang
people.known_for: Poet of the long war ballad 'Lament of the Lady of Qin' and of ci lyrics.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人、词人，以长诗《秦妇吟》和花间词闻名。

works.title: Lament of the Lady of Qin

people.line_zh: 人人尽说江南好，游人只合江南老。
people.line_en: Everyone says the south is fair; a traveller should grow old there.

people.name: Guanxiu
people.known_for: Monk, poet and painter famous for his strange, powerful arhat figures.
people.known_for_zh: 诗僧、画家，以形貌奇特的罗汉像闻名。

people.name: Du Guangting
people.known_for: Daoist master who organized Daoist rituals and wrote many Daoist works.
people.known_for_zh: 道教学者，整理道教科仪，著述甚多。

people.name: Jing Hao
people.known_for: Landscape painter of the Taihang mountains who wrote a key essay on brush technique.
people.known_for_zh: 隐居太行山的山水画家，写有画论《笔法记》。

works.title: Notes on the Art of the Brush

people.name: Yunmen Wenyan
people.known_for: Chan master who founded the Yunmen school, one of the 'Five Houses' of Zen.
people.known_for_zh: 禅师，创立禅宗五家之一的云门宗。

people.name: Yang Ningshi
people.known_for: The leading calligrapher of the Five Dynasties.
people.known_for_zh: 五代最重要的书法家。

check.n: Death year given as 954 in Chinese sources but 957 in Wikipedia/Wikidata.
check.n_zh: 卒年中文资料多作954年，英文维基作957年，说法不一。

people.name: Zhu Wen (Emperor Taizu of Later Liang)
people.known_for: Former Huang Chao rebel who ended the Tang in 907 and founded Later Liang.
people.known_for_zh: 黄巢降将，907年篡唐建后梁。

people.name: Qian Liu
people.known_for: Founder of Wuyue who built Hangzhou's seawall and kept the region peaceful.
people.known_for_zh: 吴越国创立者，修筑钱塘江捍海石塘。

people.name: Wang Jian
people.known_for: Founder of Former Shu in Sichuan, a refuge for Tang scholars.
people.known_for_zh: 前蜀开国皇帝，收容唐朝士人。

people.name: Wang Shenzhi
people.known_for: Ruler of Min who developed Fujian's economy and overseas trade.
people.known_for_zh: 闽国奠基者，开发福建，发展海外贸易。

people.name: Yelü Abaoji (Emperor Taizu of Liao)
people.place_zh: 上京临潢府（今内蒙古巴林左旗）
people.known_for: Khitan leader who founded the Liao dynasty in 907/916 and created the Khitan script.
people.known_for_zh: 契丹首领，建立辽朝，创制契丹文字。

people.name: Chen Tuan
people.known_for: Daoist sage of Mount Hua whose cosmological diagrams influenced Neo-Confucianism.
people.known_for_zh: 华山道士，所传图学影响宋代理学。

capitals.name: Chang'an
capitals.note: In 904 Zhu Wen forced the court to move to Luoyang.

capitals.name: Luoyang (Eastern Capital)
capitals.note: Second capital from 657; the court's last seat 904–907.
capitals.note_zh: 657年起为东都；904—907年为唐朝最后的都城。

capitals.name: Shendu (Luoyang)
capitals.note: Wu Zetian ruled her Zhou dynasty from Luoyang.
capitals.note_zh: 武则天以洛阳为神都，建立武周。

capitals.name: Rasa (Lhasa)
capitals.note: Songtsen Gampo moved his court to Lhasa.

capitals.name: Sanggyeong (Upper Capital)
capitals.note: Capital for most of Balhae's history, except 785–794.
capitals.note_zh: 除785—794年外一直是渤海国都城。
